# Council of AI — llms-full.txt (AI-agent discovery companion to llms.txt)

## 1. THE LID

The 22-axis GSPC board: **22 axis · 22 measured** = 14 model-comparison + 8 deterministic-fact.
Measurement, not certification. Anyone can re-check.

## 6. THE 4 ANCHORS

Every measurement is bound to 4 independent anchors:
1. HuggingFace Hub — `huggingface.co/csoai` — 60+ datasets, 42 Spaces, 3 models
2. Sigstore Rekor — witness receipt at `/signed/rekor-*.json`
3. Corrections ledger — public witness at `/api/corrections`
4. Bitcoin OpenTimestamps — irrevocable timestamp at `/api/state`

## 7. THE MCP DOOR

`POST https://councilof.ai/mcp` with the 4 free tools:
- `board_totals` — the 22 axis summary
- `get_axis` — one axis row
- `verify_card` — verify any signed card
- `list_cards` — the signed card index
Plus 5 paid tools (x402): `request-attestation`, `evidence-bundle`, `data-feed`

## 8. THE 5 ACCESS SURFACES

1. MCP — `POST https://councilof.ai/mcp`
2. Chrome MV3 extension — `/extension/`
3. Grok plugin — github.com/CSOAI-ORG/council-of-ai-grok
4. Hermes skill — `~/.hermes/skills/council-of-ai/`
5. REST + curl — `curl https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`
